killSwitch.activeBody: The global kill switch is on. No agent will run until it is resumed.
killSwitch.inactiveBody: The Agentic OS is active. Use the kill switch to pause every agent at once.
killSwitch.confirmPauseBody: This turns on the global kill switch. Every scheduled agent stops running until you resume. In-flight runs finish, but nothing new starts.
killSwitch.confirmResumeBody: This turns off the global kill switch. Enabled agents will run again on their schedules.
killSwitch.pausedToast: Global kill switch on — all agents paused.
killSwitch.resumedToast: Global kill switch off — agents resumed.
